related.title: IBM Heron 超導量子處理器
related.why: 可遷移量子狀態、控制、量測及不確定度模型；實體編碼與硬體限制需重設。
related.whyEn: Quantum states, control, measurement and uncertainty transfer, while physical encodings/hardware constraints must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移量子狀態、控制、量測及不確定度模型；實體編碼與硬體限制需重設。
related.transferEn: Quantum states, control, measurement and uncertainty transfer, while physical encodings/hardware constraints must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對量子點、交換、自旋讀出與晶圓變異；IBM Heron 超導量子處理器改以可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on quantum dots, exchange, spin readout and wafer variability; IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor centers on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照閘定義量子點與transmon 能階，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到IBM Heron 超導量子處理器，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以低溫控制熱預算為起點，設計一項能區分「量子點、交換、自旋讀出與晶圓變異」與「可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare gate-defined dots with transmon levels and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from cryogenic-controller heat budget and propose an observation distinguishing quantum dots, exchange, spin readout and wafer variability from tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control, including uncertainty.

related.title: Majorana 1 研發與奇偶量測證據
related.why: 可遷移量子狀態、控制、量測及不確定度模型；實體編碼與硬體限制需重設。
related.whyEn: Quantum states, control, measurement and uncertainty transfer, while physical encodings/hardware constraints must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移量子狀態、控制、量測及不確定度模型；實體編碼與硬體限制需重設。
related.transferEn: Quantum states, control, measurement and uncertainty transfer, while physical encodings/hardware constraints must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對量子點、交換、自旋讀出與晶圓變異；Majorana 1 研發與奇偶量測證據改以近接材料、奇偶讀出及拓撲宣稱審查為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on quantum dots, exchange, spin readout and wafer variability; Majorana 1 research and parity-measurement evidence centers on proximity materials, parity readout and review of topological claims, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照閘定義量子點與InAs–Al近接結構，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到Majorana 1 研發與奇偶量測證據，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以低溫控制熱預算為起點，設計一項能區分「量子點、交換、自旋讀出與晶圓變異」與「近接材料、奇偶讀出及拓撲宣稱審查」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare gate-defined dots with inas-al proximity structures and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Majorana 1 research and parity-measurement evidence, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from cryogenic-controller heat budget and propose an observation distinguishing quantum dots, exchange, spin readout and wafer variability from proximity materials, parity readout and review of topological claims, including uncertainty.
